info.name: RAKI API
info.description:
RAKI API - Coffee cart management platform.

## Authentication
- Login via password, OTP, or SSO to get a JWT Bearer token
- Add the token to the Authorization header: `Bearer {{token}}`
- Token expiry: 8h (password/SSO login), 30 days (OTP login)

## Variables
- `base_url`: API base URL (default: https://getmovira.com/raki-api)
- `token`: JWT token (auto-set by login scripts)
- `company_id`: Your company ID (set after login)
- `cron_secret`: Secret for cron endpoints (from .env CRON_SECRET)
- `username`: Username for session queries

request.description: Get the authenticated user's profile. To change it, see Update Profile.

Update the authenticated user's own profile. Send only the fields you want to change.

No password needed for: first_name, language ('id' or 'en').

Response: { changed: [...], user: {...} }.

Changing username, email or phone_number requires current_password (only when the value actually changes). Can be combined with first_name / language in one request.

- username: lowercase letters, digits and dots, max 50. Unique across all apps (409 if taken).
- phone_number: Indonesian number, stored as 62xxxxxxxxxx. Unique within RAKI (409 if taken).
- email: valid email, max 100.
- Wrong current_password: 403 (not 401, so the app does not sign out).

If username changes, the response includes a fresh `token` and `expires_in` (same expiry as the old token). The old token stops working for profile lookups, so the app must replace it. This request's test script saves the new token automatically.

Note: sessions/transactions created before the change keep the old username in created_by.

item.name: Menu
item.description: Menu items, categories, packages, ingredients management

query.description: Include inactive menus. Needs the Owner token

request.description: List active menus. Public, no token needed (landing page). With show_all=1 it also returns inactive menus and needs the Owner token. Ordered by creation time; limit is capped at 200.

query.description: Needed to open an inactive menu. Owner token

request.description: Single menu with category, audit fields and photo URLs. Public for active menus.
Create a menu item (JSON, no photo). Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403. category_id must exist; menu_name must be unique; price >= 0.

formdata.description: JPG, PNG or WEBP, max 10 MB, max 4000px per side

request.description: Create a menu with a photo (multipart/form-data). The original and a 600px WEBP thumbnail are stored in the cloud bucket; the response returns image_url and thumb_url. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403. Over-limit uploads return 413.
Update a menu (JSON, no photo). is_active: 1 active, 0 hidden from POS and the public list. Sets updated_by / updated_at. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.

formdata.description: New photo. The previous one is removed from the bucket

request.description: Update a menu with a new photo. Must be POST with menu_id, because PHP does not parse multipart bodies on PUT. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
Delete a menu and remove its photos from the bucket. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403. To hide a menu but keep its sales history, set is_active = 0 instead.
Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
Rename a category. Name is trimmed and must be unique; sets updated_by / updated_at. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.

Delete a category. 409 "Can't delete this category: N menu(s) still use it" while any menu (active or not) is in it, and 409 while a promo still targets it. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
List all menu packages. Public endpoint.
Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.

Update name, price and/or menu list (JSON). Name must be unique, price >= 0, menu_ids a non-empty list of active menus. To change the photo, POST multipart with package_id. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
Delete a package and its photos. 409 once the package has been sold (sales history needs it). Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
Update any of the fields. Name unique within the ingredient's company; category and UOM must exist; price >= 0; is_active 0/1. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
Delete an ingredient. 409 while it is used in a supply order. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
Create an ingredient category. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
Rename. Name is trimmed and must be unique. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
Delete. 409 while any ingredient uses it. Owner role only (app_role6902bbb67a429); other roles get 403.
